text_block_list.text:
Summer has arrived in full force, and this year's training camp is underway!
North Flight continues to stay thoroughly prepared against the summer heat.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Woooow! Those sunglasses look so cool!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: They're stunning~! Maybe I should pick up a pair too...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
! When summer comes, these are an absolute must.
They help reduce workout fatigue as well, so I highly recommend them♪

A crowd of horsegirls gathered in excitement around her. As expected of a fashion leader.
At this rate, sunglasses were bound to become the defining trend of the camp.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
You really do have the best taste, Senpai~!
You always have such a lovely, subtle scent on you too...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You noticed? It's a new eau de toilette♪
It has a crisp, refreshing fragrance that's perfect for a humid summer, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Just as I'd expect~! Senpai... how do you manage to stay
so effortlessly stylish all the time? Is there a secret to it?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A secret, hmm...
Well, if I had to name one—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'd say it's about "discovering more things that make your heart flutter."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I love this," "This makes me happy," "This is exciting."
The more of those feelings you gather, the broader your world becomes.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: I see~! So it's about keeping your antennas up, right?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, that's a wonderful mindset to have!
And besides...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, it's also about letting someone special inspire you... right?♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... Whenever I'm with them, those moments just keep growing.
Before I knew it, they'd given me so much...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
Oh, I just had a wonderful idea♪

That night—having some extra time, I was getting ahead on future work
when I heard footsteps approaching.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Still working, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, figured I'd get a head start while I have the chance.
Yeah, figured I'd get a head start while I have the chance.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for your hard work.
You're always so dedicated, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Which... is... why... how about taking a breather just for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We've come all the way to the beach, so
I thought it might be nice for you to spread your wings a little once in a while.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I've already looked over the training schedule, you know.
With the progress we're making, a slight adjustment won't be an issue, will it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything you'd like to try during the camp, or anything you enjoy doing?
Whatever it is, please let me keep you company!

Put on the spot, nothing came to mind right away.
As I hesitated, wondering why she was asking so out of the blue...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm...
In that case, let's go find something together.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Something brand new that will make your heart flutter, Trainer!

—And so, the next day, we wrapped up afternoon training early.
I didn't want to let her thoughtful gesture go to waste.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This is a beach resort I scouted out before camp♪
Delicious food, relaxing walks, shopping—there's so much to enjoy here!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome~!
How about some ice cream today~?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we've found a lovely shop right off the bat!
They all look delicious...! Why don't we get some?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~♪ Now this really feels like summer.
What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It's delicious! Especially this yuzu flavor...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad...! Let's keep this momentum going and enjoy ourselves to the fullest♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Waaah, so lively♪ To think they even have a music festival going on!
choice_data_list: This is a great track. What's it called, I wonder?
This is a great track. What's it called, I wonder?

text_block_list.text:
I ran a quick audio search on my phone.
Seeing that, North Flight looked delighted all over again.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Looks like you've found another thing that makes your heart flutter♪
choice_data_list: Another thing that makes my heart flutter...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The things that make your heart flutter, the things you love...
The moment those moments multiply within you, it creates such an incredible "radiance."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! ...I knew it, you haven't realized, have you?
You were the one who gave that to me—

—And with that, North Flight led me to a quiet spot away from the crowd.
Turning toward me, she spoke with heartfelt sincerity.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to fashion, sometimes the story behind an item is just as important.
Don't you have pieces that you find yourself oddly attached to?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps something bought to commemorate a milestone, or a treasure discovered on a trip...
Or maybe, a keepsake holding memories shared with someone dear.
choice_data_list: Those kinds of things are truly precious.
Those kinds of things are truly precious.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The sunglasses, the perfume... The reason they suddenly became my obsessions
is because you gave them a story.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
After we went shopping, I realized something!
"Being with you makes me discover more and more things I love...!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My entire world is expanding. In racing, in fashion...
And it's all thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When it hit me, I couldn't help but think...
It'd be such a waste to keep all this brilliance to myself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: So, I wanted to share it with you too, Trainer.

It all makes sense now.
Receiving such an unexpected gesture of gratitude flusters me... but fills me with warmth.
choice_data_list: (I'm glad I was really able to help her...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's why I invited you out today. Fufufu... Oh?
We got so caught up chatting that it's gotten quite dark, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is it time, I wonder?
Ah, look over there—

Where her finger points, the setting sun touches the distant ocean horizon.
A dazzling glow sparkles across the sea and the evening sky.

The words slip out effortlessly.
The reason it looks so breathtaking is because I'm here with her.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Do you like it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad! I saw in a magazine that this is a famous spot for sunsets.
I figured a view like this would "strike a chord" regardless of personal tastes.

I tell her that whenever I see a beautiful sunset, I'll surely remember today.
North Flight smiles with deep satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful. It seems I managed to repay you plenty today.
With all these wonderful feelings I've discovered...!
choice_data_list: I hope we keep discovering more from now on.
I hope we find even more from here on out.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...!
Fufu. I'm sure they'll multiply all on their own.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: As long as we're together... our world will keep expanding without end!
